edicao: Change only what the rabbit holds: no spreadsheet and no pocket watch now; he holds up in one paw, at face height, a single classic white ivory die, drawn as a solid 3D cube in three-quarter view exactly like the other dice in this panel (the top face and two side faces visible, rounded edges, thick outline, round pips), never a flat square, with black pips (one pip on the top face), and shows it to the reader with a tired, resigned look. Keep the crowded burrow full of small rabbit silhouettes, the desk with its dice, the lamp, the clock, the calendar, the colors and the drawing style identical. No text.
